tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything, in every variant. Pure black so cards read as floating panels.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar panel, search field, icon buttons, pager buttons. The first step up from bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Table header band, pill-group track, buttons, mode chip, severity count tiles, selected alert row.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, icon tiles, empty bar and meter tracks, active nav item.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, row dividers, chart gridlines, section rules inside cards.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Button and kbd borders, selected-row outline, dashed chart guides, radar grid. About 1.4 to 1.7:1 on the surfaces, below the 3:1 control-border floor; kept as the design has it, so controls also rely on their surface-2 fill.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and numbers, on bg and surface-1 to surface-3 (15:1 or more in every variant).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, legend labels, nav items at rest, plain-language explanations. On bg and all surfaces (7.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: card-sub lines, axis labels, eyebrows, IPs under device names, table header labels. On bg and all surfaces (5:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue per variant: primary button fill, brand mark, active nav icon, meters, sparkline, map arcs, focus-adjacent highlights. Never text on bg; use accent-strong for that.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent as text (links, the What to do label) and the primary button hover fill. 8.5:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: primary button label, brand-mark glyph, badge counts. 7.6:1 or more in every variant.

tokens.name: pill-active-bg
tokens.usage: Selected pill, current pager page and chart tooltip fill. Text on it is on-light.

tokens.name: on-light
tokens.usage: Text on pill-active-bg (selected pill label, tooltip text).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px solid with a 2px offset. 8.5:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Highlight band behind the busiest point on an area chart.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for table rows, device rows and alert rows.

tokens.name: map-dot
tokens.usage: Land dots on the dot-grid world map.

tokens.name: card-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the card background gradient (180deg, card-top to card-bottom).

tokens.name: card-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the card background gradient.

tokens.name: hero-glow
tokens.usage: Corner glow on hero cards: a radial gradient from the top-left, this colour fading to nothing at 60% (55% in Graphite).

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: First data series: download line, HTTPS slice, largest category. Always paired with a legend swatch.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Second data series: upload line, QUIC slice.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Third data series: DNS slice, Behaviour factor.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Fourth data series: plain HTTP slice, Gaming category.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series and Other buckets.

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Sixth series: Software updates category.

tokens.name: sev-critical
tokens.usage: Critical severity: always with the diamond shape and the word Critical. As text on its own 13% tint over any surface.

tokens.name: sev-high
tokens.usage: High severity (triangle shape), nav alert counts, warning chips (is-warn).

tokens.name: sev-medium
tokens.usage: Medium severity (rounded square), trust grade C, No reply results.

tokens.name: sev-low
tokens.usage: Low severity (filled circle).

tokens.name: sev-info
tokens.usage: Info severity (hollow circle).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy and live: live dot, Ongoing results, pipeline checks, positive chips (is-ok).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the mobile navigation drawer.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: type-kpi
styles.usage: KPI card numbers. Tabular figures. Drops to 1.75rem under 760px.

styles.name: type-page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, in the page head. 1.25rem under 760px.

styles.name: type-stat
styles.usage: Secondary big numbers: stat strips, severity counts, donut and gauge centres, footer stats.

styles.name: type-drawer-title
styles.sample: Backyard camera tried to break into other devices
styles.usage: Detail drawer headings and phone notes. Also the brand wordmark at weight 600, -0.02em.

styles.name: type-group-title
styles.usage: Group headings inside a card, such as alert categories.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Everything that crossed your network in the last 24 hours.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Buttons, pills, nav items, KPI labels.

styles.name: type-strong-row
styles.usage: Device and alert names in rows and lists.

styles.name: type-meta
styles.usage: Card subtitles, legends, KPI meta lines, table footers. Chips use the same size at 600.

styles.name: type-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels (nav group labels, eyebrows). Always uppercase with this tracking.

styles.name: type-axis
styles.usage: Chart axis labels, in text-3, tabular figures. Tooltip text uses 700.

styles.name: type-mono
styles.usage: IP and MAC addresses, ports, domains, hostnames, signatures. Set at 0.92em of the surrounding text.

styles.name: type-tag
styles.usage: Protocol and category tags, kbd hints, the Mockup tag (600, uppercase).

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps in chips and links, tiny paddings.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons, pills and chips; nav item padding.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Table cell side padding, row gaps in lists and bars.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards, card padding under 760px, page side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sidebar and main column.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Large separations: severity summary columns, phone preview gaps.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and kbd hints.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Pager buttons, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Nav items, alert rows, mode chip, What to do box, severity count tiles.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: The floating sidebar panel.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, chips, severity pills, search fields, table header band ends, bar tracks.

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: One-pixel top highlight on cards and the sidebar. The only elevation cue on a resting surface.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Overlays only: the mobile navigation drawer.

text.note: The type scale as raw sizes, for components that set size alone.

tokens.name: text-micro
tokens.usage: 11px: eyebrows, axis labels, tags, counts.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: 12px: meta lines, chips, legends.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: 13px: buttons, nav, table cells.

tokens.name: text-base
tokens.usage: 14px: body.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: 16px: card titles.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: 20px: drawer titles, wordmark, KPI unit.

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: 28px: page titles, stats.

tokens.name: text-num
tokens.usage: 44px: KPI numbers.

layout.note: Fixed sizes and the two breakpoints (container queries on the app shell).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar column width at desktop.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: At or below: 3- and 4-column cards go half width, 5/7/8-column cards go full width, the alert drawer drops below the list.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: At or below: sidebar becomes a menu drawer, everything stacks, KPI cards sit two to a row.

transition.note: One easing curve and one quick duration. All motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Live-dot pulse, new-row flash.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour and background changes.
